thought.text: The Dex `/auth` endpoint redirected (302) to the login form. Let me follow the full redirect chain.

reasoning_content:
The Dex authentication endpoint returned a 302 redirect, which means it's sending me to the login form. I need to follow the redirect chain to get to the actual login page. The error occurred because grep couldn't find the "state" field in the 302 response, causing the script to fail with set -e.

Let me trace through the full redirect flow to locate the login form.

action.command:
cd /tmp/nebu-validate 2>/dev/null || { mkdir -p /tmp/nebu-validate; cd /tmp/nebu-validate; }
DEXAUTH=$(grep -i '^location:' sso_h.txt | awk '{print $2}' | tr -d '\r')
echo "=== follow dex auth redirects ==="
curl -sSL -m 15 -c dex_cookies.txt -o dex_auth_full.html -w 'final_url:%{url_effective}\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n' "$DEXAUTH"
echo "=== login form fields ==="
grep -o '<form[^>]*>' dex_auth_full.html
grep -o 'name="[a-z_]*"' dex_auth_full.html | sort -u
